name: Owen Smith in Memoriam Engineering Scholarship
summary: Up to $5,000 for penultimate-year Griffith engineering students facing educational disadvantage.
who: Full-time in the penultimate year of the Bachelor of Engineering (Honours), including double degrees.
Australian citizen, permanent resident, permanent humanitarian visa holder, New Zealand citizen or Pacific Engagement visa holder.
how: Apply through Griffith's online scholarship application process.
catches: Preference for students of Pacific Islander heritage.

source.label: Griffith University: Owen Smith in Memoriam Engineering Scholarship

evidence.quote: demonstrate educational disadvantage based on a comprehensive assessment by the University.
